title: [Bug] Accept All Edits mode not functioning - requires manual intervention for each edit
body:
**Bug Description**
The "accept all edits" is not working - asking me to intervene with every edit

also, planning mode not working correctly - it was asking me for permissions to read things and then switching into "accept all edits". normal behavior would have been to simply read the thing and continue planning

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: iTerm.app
- Version: 2.0.35
- Feedback ID: ba43436d-620b-4bf9-8f58-4fa660570d6a
